system.name: ntprof
system.one_liner: a profiling system for NVMe-over-TCP that models the storage substrate as a multi-stage Clos-like network of software switches and attaches programmable profiling agents to each modeled queue

content.key_idea: ntprof profiles NVMe/TCP by modeling the initiator-target I/O path as 9 pipeline stages (a Clos-like network of software switches), attaching a Profiling Agent to each stage's modeled queue to collect per-app statistics reconstructed into a report.
content.reading_order: Left to right: Programmer configures a Profiling Task Specification that installs Profiling Agents across the initiator (S1-S3)/Network (S4)/target (S5-S9) stage matrix; four apps' colored paths trace through it to the Profiling Analyzer and Report.

We model the NVMe/TCP-based storage substrate as a multi-stage Clos network [36,88]
PA refers to the Programmable Profiling Agent, attached to each switching queue.

summary: ntprof is a profiling system for NVMe-over-TCP that models the initiator-target storage substrate as a multi-stage, Clos-network-like chain of buffered software switches. Figure 4 gives its system overview: a Programmer defines a Profiling Task Specification (workload, execution, profiler, and report settings), translated into rules installed on Profiling Agents (PA) co-located with every Modeled Switching Queue. The right side lays out this queueing model as a matrix of nine pipeline stages, S1-S3 on the initiator (blk_mq, NVMe/TCP Transport, TCP/IP NStack), S4 the Network, and S5-S9 on the target (TCP/IP NStack, NVMe/TCP Transport, blk_mq, NVMe/PCIe, SSD), against four example applications (app1-app4), each drawn as a distinctly colored path through the queues it uses; app1 and app2's paths overlap at Stage 2 because both map to the same queue. Collected agent statistics flow to a Profiling Analyzer that reconstructs the I/O profile into a Profiling Report.

notes: Given the figure's extreme density (over 300 text boxes across a 4-app x 9-stage matrix), components are described at the level of one representative queue/agent per stage rather than enumerating every individual cell; the exact queue-sharing pattern for stages beyond S2 is read from the figure's colors/lines since the caption's explanation is cut off.
